remarks:
Welcome to 7 South St in Panama NY, a beautifully transformed property that was gutted and completely redone from top to bottom. Thoughtful updates throughout combine modern style, comfort, efficiency, and versatile living space.

The main home features 2 bedroom, 1.5 baths, luxury vinyl flooring, heated floors on both levels, new windows, new wiring, spray foam insulation throughout, mini splits, and a cozy gas fireplace. At the heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen featuring an abundance of cupboard space, stainless steel appliances, a built-in wall oven, and built in microwave. Just off the kitchen is a dedicated coffee and wine bar area, creating the perfect spot for your morning coffee, evening glass of wine, or additional space when entertaining family and friends.

The bathrooms have also been completely updated, including an upstairs bathroom featuring a spacious walk-in shower. The laundry room is conveniently located upstairs, keeping everyday necessities close to the bedrooms. Additional improvements include a new roof and an on demand hot water system.

Step outside to the covered back patio, an inviting extension of the living space where you can relax, entertain, enjoy outdoor dining, or simply take in the beautiful surrounding scenery.

The property also features an impressive 28 x 32 heated floors in garage with epoxy flooring, providing plenty of space for vehicles, storage, hobbies, or a workshop. Above the garage is a separate one-bedroom apartment complete with its own kitchen, bathroom, living area, and mini split system. This additional space offers tremendous flexibility for guests, extended living arrangements, a home office, or potential rental income, subject to applicable local requirements.

From the completely renovated main home and stylish kitchen with its own coffee and wine bar to the covered patio, heated garage, and separate apartment, 7 South St. offers a unique combination of modern updates, functionality, and versatility in the Panama community.
